data.text:
LOOK: Land Transportation Office Chief Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao shows footage of a traffic incident involving the son of transport blogger James Deakin during a briefing at the LTO Central Office in Quezon City on Wednesday, January 7. 

Lacanilao says Deakin’s son violated traffic laws for reckless driving after his vehicle crossed a double solid line on the Skyway, causing traffic disruption, and notes that the car lacked proper registration and was only carrying dealer-issued documents.

📷: Santi San Juan | MB
